deadline.value: Complete your application by December 15, 2026 for autumn 2027 (autumn entry only).
deadline.quote: UW ECE enrolls graduate students once per year in the autumn quarter. | Applications must be completed by December 15.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required or accepted.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are no longer required or accepted for admission to our MS or Ph.D. programs.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You pick up to four research areas, which are used to match you with potential advisers; no rule on prior faculty agreement is stated.
supervisor.quote: Areas are used to match graduate students with potential faculty advisers.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students may receive RA/TA, fellowship or departmental funding while making satisfactory progress; no guarantee or share is stated.
funding.quote: Admitted Ph.D. students may receive funding through research and teaching assistantships, fellowships and departmental support provided they are making satisfactory progress toward their degree.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required before applying to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: It is not required for one to have a Master’s degree before applying to our Ph.D. program.

notes: ECE strongly suggests meeting the Graduate School's 'ELP Satisfied' scores (TOEFL 92 / 4.5, IELTS 7.0) to be competitive.
